scope: smallest pure cached-prediction F1-first selector; accepts already-authenticated arrays/mappings and returns selection/frozen identity; no real data, no fits, no Qwen
objective: replace the frozen historical minPR-first TRAIN-OOF ranking with a prospective F1-first ranking over all saved candidate OOF probabilities, without any new scientific fit and without validation ever influencing selection

prospective_rule.per_candidate_tau_rule: within one candidate pick the eligible tau maximizing F1, then min(precision,recall), then |tau-0.5|, then smaller tau
prospective_rule.note: the historical rule stays the recorded result of prior runs; this rule never rewrites them

policy: TRAIN grouped OOF only: max pooled OOF F1, then max min(precision,recall), then lower width, lower C, binary family, |tau-0.5|, smaller tau, unprompted

validation_firewall.validation_reads_allowed_only: after the selection is frozen, at the frozen tau, and only for the matching-C artifact

read_order: 1. root pins every source file by sha256 and rejects non-finite/malformed input
2. read TRAIN OOF only: oof_case_ids/oof_truth/oof_p_self for 42 new + 6 reference candidates
3. read the saved full-TRAIN artifact C index for the 16 cells
4. select on TRAIN OOF only and freeze selection + frozen_identity
5. only after freeze: if the winning cell's artifact C equals the selected C, read the saved predictions and recompute at the selected tau
6. otherwise stop and report REQUIRES_SEPARATELY_LOCKED_REFIT; never borrow a different-C model
candidate_to_cell_rule: the first four |-separated fields of a candidate id are its cell id

candidate_pool.new_rule: compression_comparison_v2: 7 cells (unprompted pca8/16/32, prompted pca8/16/32/full3072) x 2 families x C in {0.1,1.0,10.0}
candidate_pool.reference_rule: linear_span_20260914_v1 reused unprompted full-3072 baseline: 2 families x C in {0.1,1.0,10.0}

fail_closed_rule.trigger: the winning candidate's C differs from its cell's saved full-TRAIN refit C
fail_closed_rule.behavior: report the frozen selection plus the requirement; never borrow a different-C model, never reuse wrong-C predictions, never refit inside this selector

post_freeze_recompute.condition: saved artifact C equals the frozen selected C
post_freeze_recompute.inputs: already-saved prediction JSON only; no model pickle deserialization
post_freeze_recompute.rule: metrics recomputed with the existing harness.binary_gate_metrics at the frozen tau; selection and frozen identity unchanged

synthetic_acceptance: prospective F1-first winner differs from the frozen minPR-first preference on a constructed pool
select has no validation parameter and rejects any validation-like pool field
mismatched-C new refit fails closed and refuses post-freeze recompute
mismatched-C reused reference baseline fails closed; matching C authorizes recompute
NaN / out-of-range / short OOF rows, duplicate train ids and missing truth coverage are rejected
candidate case-order and truth-order mismatches are rejected
post-freeze split case-order mismatch is rejected
frozen identity binds all 48 OOF arrays, source pins and artifact C pins

next_experiment_recommendation.hypothesis: the SELF-vs-OTHER identity distinction, not more arbitrary wording, is the next useful target
next_experiment_recommendation.design: compare the same fixed three-question suffix (responder / affected-process / permanence) against the current one-question prompt using the same data and PCA32
controls: identical fixed suffix for every case
no per-class different questions or answers
same grouped TRAIN folds and ancestry split
next_experiment_recommendation.capture: a new reviewed finite capture is required only if later released

prohibited_actions: no network, install, Git or coordination edits
no real data/results/probabilities/datasets read in this job
no model, tokenizer, lens or activation work
no estimator fit, PCA fit or threshold tuning
no use of global validation-best as a TRAIN winner
